content.short: Haedal is a leading liquid staking protocol on the Sui blockchain that optimizes capital efficiency for all users.
content.description: Haedal Protocol is a premier liquid staking solution built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to maximize the utility of SUI tokens. By staking assets with Haedal, users receive haSUI, a liquid token that represents their position while earning network rewards. This allows participants to remain liquid and utilize capital across other Sui DeFi protocols like DEXs and lending markets. The protocol aims to strengthen the Sui ecosystem by providing a seamless and secure staking experience. Haedal empowers the community to grow assets without compromising on decentralization or security.
content.meta: Haedal provides a liquid staking protocol on the Sui blockchain via haSUI. Discover Haedal and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
